metadata.description: Agent Skills by TarikAI. Currently ships Adminwright, which makes any coding agent build a real, verified admin console instead of a decorative one.

plugins.name: adminwright
plugins.description: Build a real admin console, not a mock one. Models the platform's control plane in a manifest, then a validator blocks completion until every screen traces to a real server operation, a server-side policy, an authoritative data source, an audit event, a test, and evidence that resolves on disk.
